page.layout: One printed page: a running head at the top, then a chronological table of years in a left column with entries ruled beside them on the right.; One column of short italic paragraphs, running down the page below the printed page number at top right.

main_text.l: 1278 | Hugo Almaers Consul inGro-ningen nominatur in quodam instrumento.

p.i: Nomina vicorum[?], & locorum, quos sinus iste hausit, dedimus alibi.
Pactum Groning. cum Menternensibus & definita controversia de judicandis Selwerdiis.
Hi in munere cōsulari non fuere.

page.notes: Long s is printed as f in the first line ("finus") and read as sinus. The "u" in "vicorum" carries a mark that could be a macron or tilde; read as vicorum with [?]. The tilde over "o" in "cōsulari" stands for a left-out n. Only the right-hand printed text is shown, as instructed.
